title: Can I BEAT Who Takes the Crown?
summary: 'Who Wears the Crown?' (title says 'Takes'): a Getting-Over-It-style vertical platformer where a little pawn climbs a tower of chessboards to claim the royal crown; failing a jump can drop you all the way down. Unlocked boards are playable chess positions vs Stockfish level 1300; you move pieces to build platforms, and delivering checkmate grants a Super Jump that passes through rows of pawns to the board above. He completes the tutorial map in 36:39.
rules: Platformer: tap Space = small jump; hold Space = bigger jump; hold too long = failed jump and you fall.
Boards with a lock icon are fixed scenery; unlocked boards let you make chess moves vs Stockfish (~1300) to rearrange pieces into platforms.
Pieces on boards act as solid blocks to stand/jump on.

Checkmate on a board grants a Super Jump: press E to activate, hold Space to charge; it lets you jump through pieces (rows of pawns) to the next board. Miss it and you reset or checkmate another board for another super jump.
Checkpoints: crossing one sets respawn; R respawns at last checkpoint.
win_condition: Reach the top of the tower and take the crown.

board.shape_notes: Vertical tower of several 8x8 boards linked as rooms; pixel-art platformer world
board.theme_notes: Red/burgundy checkered boards (scene colours), teal special tiles, picture frames, tutorial text ('hold and drag to...').

current_impl_issues: Mapped to King of the Hill - unrelated. Needs platformer-with-chess-boards remake (or a simplified 'checkmate to climb' board ladder).
